name: logo-cloud
title: Logo cloud
description: "Trusted by" section with customer logos in five layouts: row, grid, CSS marquee, quote cards, and stats.

props.name: logos
props.type: { name: string; href?: string; path?: string; viewBox?: string; wordmark?: boolean; quote?: string; author?: string }[]
props.description: Logos. path is an SVG path filled with currentColor; the name shows as a wordmark unless wordmark is false. Custom markup: React logo field, Vue logo slot, Blade slot named after the array key, Svelte logo snippet, Astro function child (logo, index), Angular ng-template child.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading (h2), for example "Trusted by 2,000+ teams".

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout: a wrapping row, a lined grid, an endless CSS marquee, cards with a short quote, or a heading with big numbers beside the logos.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Muted grayscale logos that turn full colour on hover.

props.name: logosLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the section when there is no title.

a11y: Every logo has a name: visible wordmark text, or role img with aria-label when only the SVG is shown.
The second marquee copy is aria-hidden and inert, so screen readers and the keyboard meet each logo once.
The marquee pauses on hover and on focus inside, and stops and wraps with reduced motion.
Linked logos get a visible focus outline and unsafe href schemes are replaced with #.

ai.whenToUse: Social proof under a hero or pricing table: brands, partners, or press that use the product.
rules: Only show logos you have permission to use
Prefer monochrome SVG paths so logos follow the theme
Use marquee for long lists and grid or row for six logos or fewer

id.description: Section "Dipercaya oleh" berisi logo pelanggan dalam lima tata letak: deret, grid, marquee CSS, kartu kutipan, dan angka.

props.logos: Daftar logo. path adalah path SVG berwarna currentColor; nama tampil sebagai wordmark kecuali wordmark false. Markup sendiri: field logo di React, slot logo di Vue, slot bernama key array di Blade.
props.title: Judul section (h2), misalnya "Dipercaya 2.000+ tim".
props.variant: Tata letak: deret yang membungkus, grid bergaris, marquee CSS tanpa ujung, kartu dengan kutipan singkat, atau judul dengan angka besar di samping logo.
props.grayscale: Logo abu redup yang berwarna penuh saat hover.
props.stats: Angka yang tampil di samping logo (stats).
props.logosLabel: Nama aksesibel section bila tidak ada judul.

a11y: Setiap logo punya nama: teks wordmark yang terlihat, atau role img dengan aria-label bila hanya SVG.
Salinan kedua marquee diberi aria-hidden dan inert, jadi pembaca layar dan keyboard menemui tiap logo sekali.
Marquee berhenti saat hover dan saat fokus di dalam, serta diam dan membungkus saat reduced motion.
Logo bertautan punya outline fokus dan skema href berbahaya diganti #.

ai.whenToUse: Bukti sosial di bawah hero atau tabel harga: merek, mitra, atau media yang memakai produk.
rules: Hanya tampilkan logo yang sudah diizinkan dipakai
Utamakan path SVG satu warna supaya logo mengikuti tema
Pakai marquee untuk daftar panjang dan grid atau row untuk enam logo atau kurang
